frontTitle: Bring in front of the other images
bgTitle: Background behind this image (handy for a cut-out PNG)
posterTitle: Video placeholder image (otherwise a frame from the video)
posterClearTitle: Go back to the frame from the video
soundOnTitle: This video has sound: a sound button is shown on the site
soundOffTitle: This video is silent: no sound button
cropCellTitle: Drag to change the cell width (columns) and the board height
cropTitle: Drag to crop the board frame (Alt: no snapping, Esc: cancel)
